mapper.select:
SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'top2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS top2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.answered_rounds > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS startedCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r

SELECT a.dimension_code AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.dimension_code

SELECT t.dimension_code AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM ( SELECT a.record_id, a.dimension_code FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.record_id, a.dimension_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 ) t GROUP BY t.dimension_code

SELECT r.top1_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
AND r.top1_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.top1_dimension_id

SELECT r.top2_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
AND r.top2_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.top2_dimension_id

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, r.student_name AS studentName, r.student_no AS studentNo, r.school_id AS schoolId, r.instance_id AS instanceId, r.top1_dimension_name AS top1Name, r.top2_dimension_name AS top2Name, r.result_type AS resultType, a.round_no AS roundNo, a.option_label AS optionLabel, a.option_name AS optionName, d.dimension_name AS dimensionName FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_nlld_dimension d ON d.dimension_id = a.dimension_id
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC, a.round_no ASC, a.option_label ASC
